title: Taiwan logs 49 PLA aircraft sorties in 24 hours to 6 a.m. Nov 3
detail: Taipei Times reported 49 PLA aircraft sorties around Taiwan in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. on Nov 3, described by an analyst as a 'quiet exercise'. A secondary tracker puts 31 of them inside the ADIZ, with 6 PLAN vessels and 6 official ships. Single outlet plus secondary tracker; figures not independently confirmed.
